reviews.t: Sturdy tool. Tip isn't as pointy as the regular cuticle remover but does the job right
reviews.x: I recently received this item in the mail and here is what i thought of it: the Material is sturdy and it fits perfectly inside a small hand. It is a tiny bit bigger that my old one, and if you notice on the pics below, the tip of this isnt as pointy, its actually a bit squared and wider. Regardless of that, it did remove my cuticles just as well, I just had to get some used to it bc it was also very sharp, as a new tool should be. And It removed the cuticles without leaving any hanging pieces.
Not pleased, the blades of these nippers are uneven so they don't trim well. I will be replacing these. Very poor quality!

reviews.t: Quality Control Alert - sloppy machining: the cutting blades don't align. :(
reviews.x: Sloppy machining - the cutting blades aren't ground parallel to each other. When you squeeze the cutters, only the tips of the cutting blades touch. This leaves anything below the absolute tip crimped, but uncut. Given that these are cuticle nippers, that means torn aggravated skin that's not cleanly cut through, which has to be re-cut or, even worse, torn off. Ouch! What a shame - the size of these is perfect otherwise, and the pusher tool is well manufactured.
Used them the same day I received them (which, by the way, was super-fast).  High quality, sharp - all girls know this is one of those "must have" tools. :-)
My nail tecknician loves to use them and she makes sure they are sterilized before I go home!

Okay defiantly five stars for this cuticle nipper and pusher set. I love it. I am one of those people that prefer to do my own nails. I really don’t like to get my cuticles cut at nail shops because not all of them sterilize there instruments and I have had my cuticles bleed from them before. Anyway, this set is great, it is very sharp and this is important so that you get a good even quick cut. I have bought cuticle nippers before and if they are not sharp they just make a mess of your cuticles

reviews.t: Not a bad set. The cuticle pusher isn't curved
reviews.x: Not a bad set.  The cuticle pusher isn't curved, which makes a difference for me.  The cuticle nippers are nice and sharp, and that is why I ordered these.  They squeeze easily and have survived being dropped a few times.  I mention that cause I had a very expensive set of a major brand name that was nice and sharp but somehow came apart sitting in a drawer. Shipping was fast too.

A real dissapointment.  The nippers are very dull, I have bought Revlon cuticle nippers that are sharper than this one.  After reading all the reviews, which  are mostly positive, I thought this brand would perform better than the typical drug store kind but the quality is just not there

This is a smallish but quite solid stainless steel nipper that works quite well. It is sharp and well shaped for my size hands( medium male). The double ended pusher is also good stainless and works well. I am pleased with the purchase.

reviews.t: The nippers are very easy to use and seem to be more reliable than ...
reviews.x: The nippers are very easy to use and seem to be more reliable than other nippers that I have had with the moveable lever that usually loses their strength.  I am not sure how to say it, but this nipper is much better.

reviews.t: Appears to be a good value for the price
reviews.x: Material used feels solid and well built. Appears to be a good value for the price.
They work great!! My cuticles look like the salon did it!
Quality but high cost. Overall I'm pleased.

This set of cuticle nippers and cuticle pusher is an absolute must for your nail care needs. The nippers are excellent quality with thin, well sharpened tips that clip cuticles without pulling or tearing. I'm very particular when it comes to nail care products and I only use ones that can be resharpened when necessary. It's miserable when you use poor quality and cut your cuticles all up then have to wait for them to heal. These worked so well, I was able to trim the most delicate areas with eas

reviews.x: This set of nail tools are very good! They are made of very good stainless steel material. You can feel the quality of the material by their weight, they feel solid. I tried them, and they were very sharp and they cut my cuticles very good. reviews.t: Fabulous gift for anyone.  Now they are mine.
reviews.x: Just received these clippers in the mail.  They are awesome.  Furthermore, the neat thing about the cuticle pusher is the very small side which can be used to push back my grandchildren's cuticles.  Small enough for every child's finger nails.  It is usually so difficult caring for children's nails, but now, I won't have any problem.  Love them.  Both the clippers and the cuticle pusher are made of quality stainless steal.  Much better than the ones I have purchased in the past.  I was able to f

before I purchased this product I read people's experience with this tool. Let me tell you, I did a good purchase here, I have had the chance to use brand name tools like this one and they don't work as awesome as this one. I hit jack pot with this tool. I love it and I'm actually purchasing another set because I want my sister to try it.

Unfortunately, the nippers weren't at all sharp. Instead of cutting, they just grasped my skin when I tried to cut. I've spent less money on sharper tools from Rite Aid. The cuticle pusher was nice & I wish I could've kept that, but I'll be returning everything. No sense in keeping it if I'm never going to use it.

Fast delivery and the products work as they are described. I had this cuticle nipper for about a year and I loved it so much. Unfortunately, it was confiscated by the airport authority when I put it in my carry-on. I immediately ordered it again online at the airport and got it 2 days after I arrived home.

I have been using the same clippers for years.  I didn't realize how dull and bad off they were until I received these nippers.  Oh my, they are so sharp and precise!  I am not going to wait too long next time I purchase a new set of clippers.  They are definitely worth purchasing every so often!

reviews.t: what I didn't like about it is that you cannot remove or undo ...
reviews.x: The nipper was fairly sharp.  However, what I didn't like about it is that you cannot remove or undo the spring that keeps the blades apart.  I am not used to using the spring and usually open and close the nipper manually.  I will have to unscrew the separators.

These nippers are the absolute best!  They are super sharp and cut perfectly.  The cuticle pusher is also useful and sturdy.  As a former nail technician, these two tools are what I prefer to use for my own nails.  I highly recommend them!

reviews.t: They are very sharp and work great for at home manicures
reviews.x: I bought these mostly for the cuticle nipper.  They are very sharp and work great for at home manicures.  The cuticle pusher is also very sharp so be cautious.  I accidentally gouged my nails a couple times.  Nice product for the price

reviews.t: ... beauty tools and it really made my nails look nice! I did it easily and they really did ...
reviews.x: I needed a manicure and didn't have time so I used these beauty tools and it really made my nails look nice! I did it easily and they really did the job. They are well made and come in a cute little bag! Love these beauty tools!
I had higher hopes for this set.  I like that the nippers are spring-hinged, but they are an odd angle and kind of thick so I don't feel like I can get close enough along the sides of my nails.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the nippers as sharp and high quality, cutting cuticles cleanly.
Several reviewers describe the tools as solid, sturdy, and well-built.
A notable minority report poor quality with misaligned or uneven blades that don't cut well.
Some reviewers find the nippers dull and disappointing compared to other brands.
Reviewers mention the tools are easy to use and good value for the price.
